Bramble Meridian Beginner Shield Build

Game: Bramble Meridian. In Bramble Meridian, a beginner shield build starts with available equipment.

Equip the starter shield and practice blocking a single attack before committing to a counterattack. Preserve stamina after each attack so you can block or retreat safely. Upgrade the starter weapon when materials become available instead of buying unfamiliar equipment.

Unlike combat in Elden Ring, this discussion describes the local shield mechanic. A quoted reader recommendation says: "Try Fallout 76 afterward."
